author: Rombeyy
body:
Age: 16

Timezone: gmt -3

Do you have Teamspeak? Yes

Do you have Discord?Yes

Do you have access to a recording software?Yes



CRITERIA 1: SELF REFLECTION/EVALUATION 


Do you have any experience as a moderator on other servers? Yes, I do


What is your biggest weakness and how will it affect your moderating? Sometimes I can be a bit inactive because of school or just because I don't rlly feel playing but I don't think it can rlly affect my moderating


What qualities do you think a leader must have? Someone that could have control of his team, someone that knows how to work with others and that could handle situations that maybe other ppl could not.

Would you consider yourself a leader? Why/why not? Nop, I never liked to be a leader, I always liked to follow instructions and not made them, I feel I need more experience to be a leader.


What attributes distinguish yourself from other players that qualify you to be a moderator? My experience, I think that that's my main distinguish that makes me different to others, since I saw before many of the ppl that applys or even that it's in the staff team doesn't have any previous experience at all.


What skills do you believe you should have when interacting with the community? I mean I think I'm already known in the community but I feel I could be closer to the Spanish community of the server since there are 1/2 Spanish staffs that in my opinion they are not as active interacting with the community as I would ( my opinion )

Do you believe you have these skills? Yes, I do


What in your opinion are the three main character traits a moderator must have when moderating?

-Responsibility 

-Knowledge about what he is doing

-Maturity 



CRITERIA 2: GENERAL SITUATIONS


You notice a moderator giving out a lot of false bans. They almost always have insufficient evidence or sometimes no evidence and they don’t seem to care. You notice it but other staff members don’t. What would you do? Talk about it with Highers and let them know what I feel about the situation and if I had proof about it I would give it to them.


You are in Teamspeak with a few other players and they begin talking quite disrespectfully about a particular staff member. You agree with what they’re saying to an extent, but the conversation starts to become racial and very disrespectful soon after. You are all in a nightclub channel where this is allowed. What would you do? I mean it's not good at all I don't like racist ppl at all but it's the nightclub I can't do anything about it, those are the rules of the channel.



You are in an Avicus team. One of your teammates is also an Avicus Staff member. One day in your team discord the team member/staff member posts a screenshot of a thread that only staff members can see. The content in the screenshot isn’t very important/confidential but only staff members could see it on the forums. If anything, what would you do? I would try to pm him saying if he could delete that image since it's supposed to be for staffs only, and if he doesn't then I would let a higher know about it.



Some senior staff members are in teamspeak joking around with each other. They are removing others ranks, creating certain channels and even harassing certain users. They don’t mean any harm but some players in the channel feel a bit angry that they are using their permissions the way they are. What would you do? I don't like at all when staffs abuse their power so I would pm a higher ASAP and let them know that there is a staff "abusing" or making ppl mad in the ts.



CRITERIA 3: OTHER

NOTE: This is a new criteria and these questions are less to do with right/wrong answer and more to do with us getting to know you. Please answer these honestly. There is no right or wrong answer.



Why do you want to be a moderator?As i said in my past Application i feel that the server needs staffs with more experience than just playing in avicus and being nice to others, that last thing it's rlly important but I don't feel that being nice it's not the definition of a Moderator. I think that I have a different way to see the things that sometimes could be seen rude or immature but in reality most of those things could actually help the server a lot.


What does Avicus mean to you? I said it before and I will say it again, this server made me comeback to minecraft because of the competitive scene it brings that at that moment was awesome, now it's kinda dead but sometimes i still have that motivation to play just because of those moments that I used to had on OCN and that I can bring back playing here.


Anything specific the staff team could do better? New ideas and not just staying with what they have already.


Why did you choose to apply at Avicus? Because I feel that Avicus has the potential to be a mainstream server but because of the ideals that the server has it's not happening.


Do you have anything else to add to your application? As I said in my Translator Application I thing I have changed a lot since my past apply, I think I'm more mature now and I can handle situations that in that moment I would not.
